concerns.text: FR-001 (Dataset Validation & N>=30 Gate) and SC-001 (Sample Size) lack a completed task. T002b is marked incomplete. The spec mandates a hard halt if N<30 or variables are missing; without a completed task, this requirement is unimplementable.

FR-002 (Artifact Rejection) is partially covered but incomplete. T012a (Epoch Rejection >±100µV) and T012b (Segment Length <120s) are marked incomplete. The spec requires these exclusions to be logged; missing tasks mean the exclusion logic is not guaranteed.

FR-003 (Complexity Metrics) is incomplete. T016 (Permutation Entropy) is marked incomplete. The spec requires BOTH LZC and PE; missing T016 means the feature extraction is incomplete and the requirement unmet.

FR-005 (Benjamini-Hochberg Correction) is incomplete. T021 is marked incomplete. The spec mandates this correction for all electrodes; without a completed task, the statistical validity requirement is unmet.

FR-006 (Sensitivity Analysis) is incomplete. T022 is marked incomplete (despite the analyze report noting a contradiction, the task itself is unchecked). The spec requires a discrete check at p≤0.05 and p≤0.01; missing task means unmet requirement.
SC-004 (Collinearity Diagnostics) is incomplete. T037 is marked incomplete. The spec requires VIF < 5 as a gate; missing task means the success criterion cannot be verified.

SC-002 (Runtime ≤6h) and SC-003 (Memory ≤7GB) lack completed implementation tasks. T008b (Monitoring), T027 (Memory), and T036 (Runtime) are incomplete. Without these, the deployment constraints cannot be enforced or verified.

Stale/Contradictory Tasks: T046 and T047 (Topological Contextualization) are listed as active tasks, but the 'Revision' note at the bottom of the file explicitly states 'Phase 6... has been REMOVED' as unauthorized scope creep. These tasks reference a removed scope and should be deleted to prevent confusion.

Duplicate ID: T008 is used twice. Once in Phase 1 ('Create integration test file') and once in Phase 5 ('Monitoring Infrastructure'). This creates ambiguity in the task list and violates unique ID conventions.
